scope: Integration of the Python-generated vector illustrations into the existing editable transcription
checks: All 83 figure PDFs and SVGs contain vector objects rather than embedded raster images.
Every figure preserves its source crop aspect ratio and original scan-leaf placement.
All 60 affected book pages were rendered for visual layout review.
No out-of-page text, missing glyphs or overfull TeX boxes were found.
Figure legibility was improved on scan leaves 26, 48, 49, 67, 72 and 73 without moving content to another page.
The final renders of those six leaves were inspected after recompilation.
Figure 76 parameter labels were moved into open space to avoid crossing curves.
qualifications: Page content and original page labels are preserved, but typography and line wrapping are newly set; this is not a pixel facsimile.
External comparison curves without original numerical tables are approximate visual digitizations, not newly solved exact results or raw experimental data.
Formula choices, applicable numerical regimes, curve joins and source-caption discrepancies are recorded in figures-manifest.json and the Python source.
